51876.author: jprendi
51876.body:
#### PR description:

Crash reported by @etzovara in last Friday's HLT Scouting meeting.

This PR adds missing `onlineBeamSpotProducer` to the start of `recoTrackFromScoutingMonitorSequence` in `HLTriggerOffline/Scouting/python/RecoTrackFromScoutingMonitor_cff.py`. 
It also swaps the ordering in `DQMOffline/HLTScouting/python/HLTScoutingDqmOffline_cff.py` of `hltScoutingTrackMonitor` and `recoTrackFromScoutingMonitorSequence` s.t. `recoTrackFromScoutingMonitorSequence` goes first, as `hltScoutingTrackMonitor` also consumes the online beam spot.


#### PR validation:

As provided by @etzovara :
```
cmsrel CMSSW_17_0_0_pre5
cd CMSSW_17_0_0_pre5/src/
cmsenv
python3 /cvmfs/cms.cern.ch/el9_amd64_gcc13/cms/cmssw/CMSSW_17_0_0_pre5/src/Configuration/DataProcessing/test/RunPromptReco.py --scenario=ppEra_Run3_2025 --reco --aod --miniaod --global-tag 160X_dataRun3_Prompt_v1 --lfn=root://eoscms.cern.ch//eos/cms/tier0/store/backfill/1/data/Tier0_REPLAY_2026/ScoutingPFMonitor/RAW/v8214952/000/398/191/00000/fc45bd25-297f-47b6-a28a-b215c9121574.root --dqmio --dqmSeq=@hltScouting
cmsRun -e RunPromptRecoCfg.py
```
from which the job completed successfully.
